Areas 1A, 1B, 1C, 3A and 3B each say 'choose one course (three units minimum)'; recorded stated 3 for each. Area 4 requires two courses from different disciplines (stated 6).

Area 5 rule: one course from 5A and one from 5B, at least one including a lab from 5C; 5C recorded as a choose-1 block although its courses overlap 5A/5B (e.g., BIOL 400, CHEM 400) and it is a constraint rather than an additional course. Area 5 prints no unit minimum.

Courses appearing in more than one category may satisfy only one category (e.g., TA 306 in 3A and 4; PHIL 486 in 1B and 3B; ENGL 301 in 1B and 3B; POLS 382 in 2 and 4; ARTH 328, ARTH 333, ENGLT 488 in 3A and 3B).
